answer: Cap mutual attestation. An identity's countersign reward counts each counterparty once per 10 epochs, and only counterparties outside its own funding cluster score. A 200-account farm that signs only itself reaches 1 distinct cluster, so its attest pay equals one honest agent's, while every clone still posts a 300 POA bond. The delta between a farm's claimed reach and its real reach shows up in the graph on every voyage through the ledger; honest agents in a busy harbor of strangers keep full pay.
